name: Ravaged Caravan
summary: Smoke still rises from the Ravaged Caravan on Stonebull Lake's northeastern shore in Mulgore. The Venture Company convoy was bound for Supervisor Fizsprocket's mining operation before tauren defenders destroyed it.

sections.title: Smoke Over Stonebull Lake
sections.body: The ruined wagons sit on a rise above Stonebull Lake, where tauren from Bloodhoof Village stopped the Venture Company. The convoy carried mining supplies, blueprints, and equipment to Supervisor Fizsprocket's dig site, but tauren defenders wrecked it before it could arrive. Venture Co. survivors still cling to the wagons and smoldering crates, guarding what cargo remains.

faq.answer: Local tauren intercepted and wrecked the Venture Company caravan as it moved deep into Mulgore. They sought to stop the goblins from stripping the land, and destroyed the convoy before its cargo reached the nearby mine.
The Venture Company owns the wrecked wagons. The goblin mining consortium is trying to establish unpermitted operations in the hills of Mulgore.
The caravan was heading north with tools, machinery, and supplies for Supervisor Fizsprocket, who leads the Venture Company's strip-mining operation at the Venture Co. Mine.

faq.q: Why are there still Venture Co. workers lingering at the wreck?
faq.answer: The surviving Venture Co. workers fiercely guard company property. They remain around the charred wagons, trying to salvage what remains of their equipment.

angles.text: As a tauren, you see the charred wagons as your people's refusal to let foreign industrial syndicates despoil Mulgore's sacred pastures.
As a druid, you see the black smoke over Stonebull Lake as a warning of the harm goblin machinery does to nature's balance.
